oracle.name: Power Pages
oracle.scope: Two signed-in runs on 2026-11-26 (f1, f2) of an edit basic form hosting single-type probe field controls (Control Style Code Component) for a DateOnly, a UserLocal date-format, a TimeZoneIndependent and a UserLocal date-time column, saved from a Europe/Kyiv browser: the hidden-input JSON values the controls' outputs posted and the Dataverse read-back after the native postback. Establishes how the form stores posted code component date values; not the control outputs, formatting or other zones.
